question_or_proposition: During Federal FY2025, was the permittee subject to the quarterly progress-reporting requirement in Section B, Schedule of Compliance, item 1(a) concerning status of cyanide compliance activities, or had that obligation terminated because cyanide effluent limitation compliance had already been achieved as referenced by 'until compliance is achieved as stated above'?
required_context: Section B(1) compliance schedule requiring achievement of cyanide effluent limitations 12 months after permit effective date
Evidence bearing on whether and when cyanide effluent limitation compliance was achieved
source_locator: farmington/final_permit.pdf, page 6, section part_i, Section B, item 1(a)
notes: The nominated clause imposes a recurring reporting obligation tied to permit compliance status, not a numeric discharge limit (Purpose A) or an effluent monitoring no-result case (Purpose C). Whether this requirement was applicable in FY2025 depends on interpreting when the 'until compliance is achieved' termination condition was satisfied.
